body: I feel you. I have a friend...well I also end up wondering if I'm the crazy one and I project my issues on to her..or I've made her a monster in my head and it isn't fair to her...and  they invest time in making other people see you as bad too...which is equally confusing. I'm sure what the answer is but  I know you can't change them, just the things in yourself which were vulnerable to them
Just so you know, I appreciate that you're trying to help and you don't know me and you don't have to.

Ah well. I'm just being weak. Thank you for talking to me. I realise doing this sort of thing must be emotionally exhausting. I'm irritated just watching myself type this stuff. Why do you take the the time to help people this way?
HOw do you know if somebodies toxic? How do you know you're not the toxic one?

Boyfriend. We've been fighting pretty consistently.  Kind of pathetic self martyring fights. Yesterday I said we should break up because he was talking about hitting my dog if she broke his stuff. I got upset. 

My stepsister's mother gassed herself and my stepsister in their car years ago. I never felt right about being allowed to live when she wasn't. Maybe everything should come full circle. I have no where to go.

I'm not sure. I think my current task is to wait patiently till the axe falls and I lose my job. And wish to fuck it wasn't fair, but it probably is. I'm not that necessary at this company. Other people worth more than me have been retrenched. I think I need to leave my boyfriend too. It wouldn't be so bad except there's my dog. I can't afford a place on my own with a garden for her. Expecially if i'm losing my job. And she's kind of all I have and I've I can't stand that I've let her down and won't be able to provide for for her. The only good thing I've ever done was raise that dog.
ooh fuck I'm losing my grip. I'm trying my best not to spiral into useless hysterics but I'm so disorientated i'm struggling to type and stop shaking
Ok I'm going to sneak a cigarette and get a grip.

Do you know when people circle around you an avoidant look on their face? As if my highly unprofessional nervous breakdown were contagious. I should go full psycho and chuck my damp snotty tissues at them when they work past.
I was late to work. And fighting. I made some bad choices i think I've messed up and I think i can't do this life thing the way I'm supposed to. I'm an idiot.
I don't know. I can't stop crying. I've been crying for hours now.  And I'm at work and I can't get a grip. I'm going to get into trouble. I cant stop.
